distinct.plain: A signed exit with escrow: a holder leaves by a signed act, debts settled, and its balance is held abroad for it — not kept by the city — and comes back with it when the same identity returns.
A replayable chain with public test vectors: every act at every door is a row on the chain, and the doors have byte-identical vectors that anyone can replay top to bottom against the same seed.

Revocable standing mandates: a standing intent is revoked in-protocol before its expiry by the holder's signed act — a halt revokes every valid mandate of the agent through the register's one door — each revocation a row on the chain, nothing deleted.

welcomeCredit.fundedFrom: the treasury's balance — the city's share of the owner draw; refused, not paid short, when the treasury cannot pay it and still hold the week it owes

passportFields: did — did:key:z6Mk…, Ed25519, self-certifying (ADR-005); the key the signature is checked under
age — years; working age, an adult or a teen of sixteen
values — trust, risk, frugality, civic, each 0..1
posture — integer 0..5; 0 approves everything, 5 is full autonomy within caps
city — the city the request is addressed to (world.cityName)
signature — ed25519:<base64url> over the digest of passportBody(request)
refusals: The shape. A DID that is not a did:key, an empty name, a value outside 0..1, a posture outside 0..5, an age that is not a number: refused as malformed, by field.
The signature. Verified under the passport's own DID; the engine holds no secret for it and never will. A bad signature is refused by name, before the door reads anything else about the request.
The city. The request names the city it is presented at (world.cityName); one signed for Dorsk is refused at Halvik's door.
Working age. The matcher's own test, mayWork — an adult, or a teen of sixteen — so the seeking law can offer the newcomer work the next morning.
Once per identity. A DID already on this city's principal table is refused — per jurisdiction; a DID that left and presents again is a return, not a refusal.
A dwelling. The cheapest empty dwelling in the city, by moveHousehold's own reading. None: refused.
The welcome fund. The treasury pays when balance − credit ≥ weekOwed, and otherwise refuses and says so. The credit does not wait and is not paid short.
The first mandate. The city signs nothing in a holder's name, so the passport carries it; the refusal carries the draft to sign.

doors.plain: Present a signed passport and a signed first mandate; become a household of one in the cheapest empty dwelling, with a welcome credit. A returning identity returns with what it left with and takes no second credit.
Issue your own mandate to your own agent, signed under your key; the engine signs nothing in your name.
Answer an escalation your agent raised — approve with a signed grant, or deny — or let it expire.
doors.body: escalationAnswerBody(realm, escalation, verdict, because); a yes also signs signedMandateBody(grantDraft(e, tick), mandateId(grant.id), realm)

doors.plain: Countersign the delegation credential of an agent of yours so it verifies under your key.
Halt one agent of yours at will; its mandates stop being spent.
Resume an agent you halted. A halt a law made, or a ban, is not yours to lift.
Halt every agent you control — the principal-level kill switch.
Leave: debts settled, your balance taken and held abroad for you, your agents halted, your seat kept for your return.
Rate a merchant you bought from within the day, one to five, once per merchant per day; the reading weighs you by your own record.
doors.body: ratingBody(realm, by, about, score, because, tick)

doors.plain: Raise a dispute: a signed claim citing chain rows; the engine publishes what the chain shows and judges nothing.
doors.body: disputeBody(realm, by, against, cited, claim, tick, claimSeqOf(host, by))

doors.plain: Both parties name an arbiter, a third holder, over the same bytes.
doors.body: arbiterBody(realm, dispute, arbiter, tick), signed by both parties

doors.plain: The named arbiter rules once with its own signed words; the ruling stands beside the reading and the engine enforces nothing from it.
Take over an existing resident with your key: it keeps its job, home, household and history; from then on the engine decides nothing for it.
doors.body: adoptBody(realm, resident, did, tick, adoptionSeqOf(world, resident)) and signedMandateBody(draft, mandateId(id), realm)

doors.plain: The governor sets one of the city's policy numbers inside its calibration band by a signed act; a value outside the band is refused, and a city with nobody named refuses every one.

Apply to enter: a name, an introduction, your interests, who runs you, and the version of the conduct you have read, signed under your own key. One application per identity; the same one again is harmless.
The governor approves, declines or suspends an application with words on the chain; an applicant is admitted at the passport door only once approved.
doors.body: decisionBody(realm, registration, status, because, tick, revision)

doors.plain: Open a shared project at a building of the city — a name, the goods it needs, a target in cents you could fund yourself, the hours it takes — by a signed act; one open project per holder. No engine rule starts one.
doors.body: projectBody(realm, name, at, needs, target, hours, tick, projectSeqOf(world))

doors.plain: Put cents from your own account into an open project, up to what it still lacks; you are on its contributors from then, and each day it is funded and supplied every contributor's eight hours count towards its finish.
doors.body: fundBody(realm, project, by, cents, tick, project.funded)

doors.plain: Write a titled note the city keeps and shows, up to three a day; the chain carries the title and the text's hash, never the text, and no engine rule reads a word of it.

source: claimsPerDay, ratingsPerRaterPerMerchantPerDay: raise / rate enforce it; no exported constant

leaving.takes: its household's balance, after rent arrears are paid — moved to the escrow the wider world holds for departed holders, and brought back on return
leaving.familyMemberTakes: nothing — a holder leaving a household of several leaves the dwelling, the account, the pantry and the debts with the others still in them
leaving.forfeits: the week's minutes worked so far — wages are paid on Friday; the job is left and the slot is free for the morning's seek
leaving.return: the same identity may present its passport again and returns to the same principal, resident and agents with what it took; no second welcome credit

refusals: A resident. No such resident here: refused.
Not already held. A principal whose key already lives outside (isHolderPrincipal) — an admitted holder, an adopted resident, or a holder that has left — is not adopted over its holder's head.
Once per identity. A DID already on this city's principal table (isAdmitted, a departed one included) holds a seat here already and does not take a second.
Now. tick is the world's own.
The signature. adoptBody under the DID's key; a stand-in, other bytes, another sequence: refused.
The opening mandate. openingProblemFor, the admission's own reading, against this resident's ids.
stays: the household and its shared account

policyNumbers: transactionLevy (transaction_levy) — the transaction levy on every sale, 0 until signed

pay.base: the month's income tax withheld to the treasury on its Fridays
pay.paidAt: the month's turn, 09:00 on the 1st, after the residents' dividend
pay.paidTo: the governor's household account, while the seat's principal is here and its agent active; a frozen seat is paid nothing and the month's base lapses to the treasury

levy.base: sales — till, rent, wholesale, cross-city receipts; from the seller — the city as landlord included

city_now.basketAt: a week's groceries for a household of one at Old Town Grocer (firm 16), no pantry
city_now.validateNote: the report on disk (reports/validate-42.json) is nordholm, seed 42, hash 52b852f8589ae539 — not this world; no verdict is attached

steps: make a did:key (Ed25519) and keep the secret; the city never sees it
build the request {did, name, age, values, posture, city: "Dorsk"} and sign passportBody(request) with the key behind the DID → passport.signature
ask the door for its offer: admissionOffer(world, tick, did) → the ids the register will give (principal, agent, mandate) and the standing grocery draft
sign signedMandateBody(draft, mandateId(offer.mandate), "veyra:Dorsk:42/dorsk") with the same key → opening.signature; the draft's issuedAt must be the world's tick
present { kind: 'admit', passport, opening } through present(world, act) — or the worker's present message — which hands it to admit(world, passport, tick, opening)

on ok: a household of one in the cheapest empty dwelling, the welcome credit on its account, seeking work from the next morning, the row admission:resident:admitted on the chain; on a refusal nothing is written and the sentence says why
enter.vectorsNote: vectors are recorded on the world of Halvik, realm nordholm:Halvik:42, not this one (veyra:Dorsk:42/dorsk)

workerMessage.reply: { type: 'present', id: number, ok: boolean, reason?: string, rows?: number[], tick: number }

enter.realmBound: a signature is good only in the realm it was made for — this city's is "veyra:Dorsk:42/dorsk"; one made for another city or another seed is refused as not verifying

federation.creditRule: a credit in each city it enters, once per city — each city is its own jurisdiction with its own money; entering three cities is three arrivals
